title: Reverse a list
prompt: Reverse the list that starts at head by changing its links, and return the new head. An empty list stays null. The supplied toArray reads a list back into an array.
hints: When you turn one node's link around, how will you still reach the node that came after it?
Keep three things: the node before, the current node, and the node after. Save the node after before changing the link.
previous = null. While node: next = node.next, node.next = previous, previous = node, node = next. Return previous.
checkLabels: One node stays as it is.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Overwrites the link before saving where it pointed, so the rest of the list is lost.
Reverses the links and then returns the old head, which is now the last node.

feedback: Draw three nodes and their arrows. For each pass through the loop, redraw the arrows and mark which node each variable holds.
